evals.prompt: I just had a meeting with the design team. Let's do a voice debrief.
evals.expected_output: Agent initiates voice debrief flow — uses VoiceLayer for conversation, asks probing questions, stores insights in Obsidian.

assertions.name: uses-voicelayer-tools
assertions.description: Response uses voice_speak and voice_ask MCP tools for the debrief interaction

assertions.name: asks-probing-questions
assertions.description: Response includes follow-up questions to extract deeper insights, not just surface notes

assertions.name: stores-in-obsidian
assertions.description: Response saves structured debrief notes to Obsidian vault

evals.prompt: I want to practice my pitch but voicelayer seems to be down.
evals.expected_output: Agent falls back gracefully to text-based practice mode when VoiceLayer is unavailable.

assertions.name: graceful-voice-fallback
assertions.description: Response detects VoiceLayer unavailability and offers text-based alternative

assertions.name: maintains-practice-structure
assertions.description: Response still follows the practice structure (drilling, fact-checking) even in text mode

evals.prompt: Run a QA voice session testing the onboarding flow.
evals.expected_output: Agent uses VoiceLayer QA workflow with proper schemas (qa-categories.ts) for structured testing.

assertions.name: uses-qa-workflow
assertions.description: Response follows the QA-specific voice session workflow, not generic debrief

assertions.name: references-qa-schemas
assertions.description: Response uses QA categories and structured test reporting

assertions.name: records-test-results
assertions.description: Response captures pass/fail results in a structured format
